dct_description_sm: "Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1836 by H.S. Tanner in the Clerks Office of the Eastern District of Pennsylvania."

"Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1836 by H.S. Tanner in the Clerks Office of the Eastern District of Pennsylvania." Relief shown by hachures. Reproduced from an original in the U.S. National Archives, Washington, D.C. Prime meridian: Washington. Includes table of distances for steam boat routes, from Little Rock to New Orleans, Pittsburg, and Fort Gibson. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
